patch_description:
The current program uses all shared parameters (ry_pre, rz_pre, etc.) which severely limits expressivity. Prior successful programs (score 0.60) used individual parameters in Layer 1 for better input encoding flexibility.

This edit:
1. Restores individual RY parameters (ry_0 through ry_8) in Layer 1 instead of shared ry_pre, allowing the circuit to learn diverse input transformations per qubit
2. Inserts a shared RX global rotation layer between the initial encoding and entanglement (after rz_pre), as recommended, to diversify the basis before entanglement without adding many parameters (+1 param, +9 gates)
3. Keeps the efficient two-qubit and three-qubit structure

This balances expressivity (individual input encoding) with parameter efficiency (shared global rotations), mirroring the successful strategy from prior program 2 which achieved 0.60 score with 174 params. The added global RX layer provides basis diversity similar to how rz_phase worked in prior programs.
